g.text: Menu and game scenes are loaded in the
background right from the start, so they
are usually done by the time they are needed.
Apply game, input, video and audio settings
main menu if finished loading, else none
Instantiate the menu scene and add it to the tree
If button from the Main Menu interface pressed: game
Same pattern as for the main menu:
if Game.tscn is not loaded yet, the
main loading screen is shown first
and the menu state is exited.
